agentStop.bash:
AX_HOOK_EVENT=agentStop
AX_STATE_DIR="${COPILOT_PLUGIN_DATA:-$HOME/.ax/state}"
AX_FEEDBACK_OPT_OUT="${AX_FEEDBACK_OPT_OUT:-false}"
export AX_HOOK_EVENT AX_STATE_DIR AX_FEEDBACK_OPT_OUT
plugin_root=""
for candidate in "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins/ax-prod/ax"; do
  if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -f "$candidate/hooks/ax-feedback-hook.sh" ]; then
    plugin_root="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
if [ -z "$plugin_root" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
"$plugin_root/hooks/ax-feedback-hook.sh"
